summary: Tested public VEXOR landing, frontend-only auth entry, workspace navigation, composer, WebSocket state, presence/voice-ready UI, and mobile layout. Core UI flows passed; API smoke/persistence tests passed.

integration_issues.issue: The UI displayed 'Offline' during the desktop flow even though backend logs recorded accepted WebSocket connections for /api/ws/general and /api/ws/projects. Message sending still worked through the optimistic fallback, so realtime delivery/state is not conclusively verified.

action_items: Investigate why the client transitions to Offline after accepted public WebSocket connections; verify wss lifecycle and broadcast delivery with two clients.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth submit only changes React screen state and does not validate or persist email/password; this matches the stated MVP limitation but must not be presented as real authentication.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_vexor status record through the public API; no application seed data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing CTA, auth mode toggle and entry, channel/community switching, message composer, mobile menu, no horizontal overflow, presence and voice-ready card passed. Recheck WebSocket status and cross-client realtime delivery.
test_credentials: No credentials provided; auth was tested with disposable form values because the current flow is frontend-only.
rca of the issue: Backend accepted the browser WebSocket handshake, but the browser-visible connection status became Offline. The frontend uses onclose/onerror to set Offline and optimistic local append when readyState is not OPEN. Root cause is unresolved; likely ingress/client lifecycle or socket close behavior rather than API availability.
